note: Fit the DEF/ST level on its own, on the odds-covered seasons. A defense is held out of the offensive share denominator and served the calibrated classifier's own number, which is fitted over every candidate where defenses are under 2% of the rows — so nothing in it was about defenses and nothing moved as the league did. Non-offensive TDs per team-game fell from 14-16% in 2015-2019 to 9.4-11.0% across 2023-2025: regressing rate on season gives -0.657pp a year, p=0.0008, r2=0.69. Anytime level 0.840 on 1,140 team-games (said 12.3%, actual 10.3%), log loss 0.3242 -> 0.3223. First TD level 0.900 (said 2.0%, actual 1.8%). Only DEF/ST rows move.
